gloss: to jump up; to spring up; to surge

definitions.gloss: to jump up; to spring up
definitions.explanation: To leap upward suddenly or energetically.
When prices, numbers, or statistics increase sharply.

definitions.gloss: to flip up; to fly up
definitions.explanation: When something hinged or loose springs upward.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった。
{驚|おどろ}いて{椅子|いす}から{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I jumped up from my chair in surprise.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{音|おと}がして、{子供|こども}たちが{一斉|いっせい}に{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: There was a loud noise and the children all jumped up at once.

examples.japanese: {原油|げんゆ}{価格|かかく}が{急|きゅう}に{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった。
{円安|えんやす}の{影響|えいきょう}で{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}の{値段|ねだん}が{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The prices of imported goods surged due to the weak yen.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}ウイルスの{流行|りゅうこう}で、マスクの{需要|じゅよう}が{一気|いっき}に{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がり、{品切|しなぎ}れが{続出|ぞくしゅつ}した。
examples.english: With the spread of the new virus, the demand for masks skyrocketed and they sold out everywhere.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}で{看板|かんばん}が{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The signboard flipped up in the wind.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}のボンネットが{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がって{中|なか}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: The car's hood flipped up and I could see inside.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}で{屋根|やね}のトタンが{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がり、{通行人|つうこうにん}が{慌|あわ}てて{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: The corrugated metal on the roof flew up in the strong wind, and passersby fled in a panic.

notes:
{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive form is {跳|は}ね{上|あ}げる (to flip up, to jack up).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がっている indicates an ongoing or resulting state of being elevated or having jumped up.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {椅子|いす}から{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる - to jump up from a chair
- {値段|ねだん}/{価格|かかく}が{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる - prices surge
- {跳|は}ね{上|あ}がり{式|しき} - flip-up type (of glasses, etc.)

COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE:
{跳|は}ねる (to jump) + {上|あ}がる (to go up) = {跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる (to jump up)

RELATED:
- {飛|と}び{上|あ}がる - to jump up (similar meaning)
- {跳|は}ね{上|あ}げる - to flip up (transitive)
